title: ViDA Recapitulative Statement Migration Assessor
description: Assess readiness to migrate from EC Sales Lists (recapitulative statements) to ViDA Digital Reporting Requirements: check mandatory ESL fields (seller_vat_id, buyer_vat_id, reporting_period, supply_type), identify data gaps, and surface the applicable harmonization deadline (2030-07-01 or 2035-01-01 for pre-2024 domestic regimes). Terminal node of the vida-digital-reporting-requirements chain. Zero network, zero PII.
